title: A fleet dsh sends its Apply calls to tracy-web on its own network by itself
steps: S1: on a fleet dsh with no setting, ask for the internal origin twice while tracy-web resolves, then after 5 minutes when it does not.
S2: a host that names its own origin, and a dsh that is not a fleet host.
expect: S1: http://tracy-web:8080, resolved once; then the public origin.
S2: the named origin; no guess and no lookup.
evidence: Issue #208: Apply calls went out through Cloudflare unless an operator set HOST_TRACY_API_ORIGIN; dev's tracy-dsh reaches http://tracy-web:8080 in ~80 ms

tests: a host that names an internal origin sends its calls there; the public origin stays for people (#208)
a fleet dsh finds tracy-web on its own network; a name that does not resolve keeps the public origin (#208)
